item.title: The Waste Land-译

item.description: April is the cruellest month, breeding Lilacs out of the dead land.

item.title: The Red Lantern at the Canyon's Throat

item.title: Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening

item.title: Sonnet 18
item.author: GopherDing
item.description: 可否作一比，将君比夏天？可爱有过之，温存更无前。
